task.name: Interview Question Generator
task.author: Adrian Goldner
task.description:
Generates 10-15 structured interview questions based on selected content angles and topic context. Designed for Adrian's interview-based content creation workflow with focus on CVT choir director expertise.
This task creates questions that: 1. Elicit personal experiences and stories 2. Extract practical expertise and actionable advice 3. Reveal authentic opinions and insights 4. Connect to choir directors' real challenges 5. Generate content that builds authority and trust

step.template:
Based on the topic angle **{topic-angle}** for target audience **{target-audience}**, generate interview questions that:
1. **Experience-Based Questions** (2-3 questions) - Focus on personal journey with CVT/choir management - Ask about specific challenges and breakthroughs - Request concrete examples and stories - Example: "Can you walk me through your first 'aha' moment with CVT technique?"
2. **Expertise Questions** (3-4 questions) - Extract technical knowledge and best practices - Ask about common mistakes and solutions - Request step-by-step processes - Example: "What are the 3 most common voice technique mistakes choir directors make?"
3. **Opinion/Insight Questions** (2-3 questions) - Elicit unique perspectives and controversial takes - Ask about future trends and predictions - Request preferences and recommendations - Example: "What's your controversial take on traditional choir warm-up methods?"
4. **Audience-Specific Questions** (2-3 questions) - Focus on choir directors' specific challenges - Address time constraints and practical limitations - Provide actionable implementation advice - Example: "How can busy choir directors implement CVT principles in just 10 minutes per rehearsal?"
5. **Follow-up Prompts** (3-5 prompts) - "Can you give me a specific example of that?" - "What was the result of that approach?" - "What would you do differently next time?" - "How would you explain that to a beginner?"

phrases.phrase: Was ich aus meiner Erfahrung gelernt habe...
Ein Fehler, den ich oft sehe...

## Phase 1: Warmup & Rapport (2 Fragen) *Ziel: Vertrauen aufbauen und Kontext schaffen*
[WARMUP_QUESTIONS]
## Phase 2: Core Expertise (6-8 Fragen) *Ziel: Fachwissen und praktische Ratschläge extrahieren*
[EXPERTISE_QUESTIONS]
## Phase 3: Deep Dive & Insights (2-3 Fragen) *Ziel: Einzigartige Perspektiven und Meinungen gewinnen*
[INSIGHT_QUESTIONS]
## Phase 4: Practical Application (1 Frage) *Ziel: Konkrete nächste Schritte und Zusammenfassung*
[PRACTICAL_QUESTION]
format.followup-section:
## Follow-up Prompts *Für jede Frage automatisch nachfragen, wenn die Antwort zu kurz ist:*
[FOLLOWUP_PROMPTS]
format.interview-tips: ## Interview Tips - Jede Frage aktiv zuhören und 2-3 Sekunden warten - Persönliche Geschichten und Beispiele nachfragen - Konkrete Zahlen und Daten anfordern - Meinungen und Vorlieben explizit erfragen - "Warum"-Fragen stellen, um Denkprozesse zu verstehen - Emotionale Reaktionen und Erfahrungen thematisieren

Questions are phrased conversationally, not academically
Follow-up prompts are specific and actionable
Total interview time is reasonable (30-60 minutes)
Questions align with Adrian's tone of voice
